header: Reach the Summit and Academy teams
subheadline: Delegate registration, course bookings and speaker proposals each have their own desk. Pick the channel below, or send one message and we route it to the right person the same day.
info_text: Registration and Academy enquiries are handled in Hamburg from 08:30 to 17:00 CET. Speaker proposals go to programme@helio-systems.eu until the call for papers closes on 30 September.
